relationships.basis: Both sources use the same Mercury mass and material fractions.
All three sources give complete disassembly after 31 years and 85 days.
The documents repeat a 3.8 × 10^26 W stellar capture value; usable-power assumptions differ and must be checked separately.
Each source applies a relativistic rocket relation to arrival deceleration, with different payload and efficiency context.
The three documents repeat the 0.99c reach and galaxy-count row rather than providing independent evidence.
Both state the same 388-million-galaxy inference for a five-billion-year origin.
Both give the four-stage RK4 weighted update.
Both documents decompose the lunar telemetry loop as 1.3 + 4.0 + 1.3 seconds.
The review disputes the unqualified FAT capability inventory and requires a pinned release.
The review accepts the impact-energy arithmetic but disputes the grain-size interpretation.
The review identifies a sign error when the potential uses the conventional negative value.
The review reports that the displayed laser-sail equation does not reproduce the table values.
The design documents repeat the attometer-scale, million-ton black-hole engine and Dyson-powered laser infrastructure.
